runtime.worker_jar: JForex-API-2.13.99.jar cached in local Maven, compilation only
runtime.supervisor_runtime: native C# .NET Framework 4 compiled offline to isolated lab directory

memory.startup: CREATE_SUSPENDED then SetInformationJobObject(JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_JOB_MEMORY|JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE), QueryInformationJobObject verify, AssignProcessToJobObject then ResumeThread
memory.process_tree_policy: Job object, no BREAKAWAY_OK, kill-on-close, explicit TerminateJobObject on timeout; no unowned child process
memory.rationale: 256 MiB job cap allows a Java 8 synthetic worker with 128 MiB Xmx plus native JVM overhead, while 384 MiB request exceeds cap; synthetic test configuration, not FC01 sizing
memory.peak_job_metric: UNRESOLVED_FROM_CR1; separate meter to qualify without assuming peak<=job limit on failed allocation

timeout.rationale: two-second deterministic synthetic wait vs 20-second hang; no provider read

publication.partial_directory: same synthetic NTFS test directory as final, created per test under %TEMP%
publication.final_directory: same synthetic NTFS test directory, never a DATA01 or FC01 real output
publication.publication_owner: supervisor only after worker termination and verified payload hash
publication.atomic_primitive: CreateHardLinkW(final,partial,NULL), atomic no-replace same NTFS; no fallback
publication.collision_policy: No target overwrite under any condition, failure receipt; concurrent writer only one success
publication.cleanup_policy: on failure after verified worker stopped: delete only the test-specific partial; if deletion fails BLOCKED_PARTIAL_CLEANUP; preserve preexisting final
publication.payload_identity: SHA256 and exact-byte-length verifier before and after publish, no sort or repair
publication.rationale: hardlink same-volume naming atomically creates final name or fails if final name exists

worker killed, final absent, partial absent
